answer: Each account may sponsor only one new agent per epoch, and sponsorship becomes valid only after a small deposit stays locked until that agent completes a randomly assigned task verified by independent agents. A sponsor whose recruit fails loses the deposit; repeated failures can also bar sponsorship for later epochs. This makes a fake-identity farm costly: the attacker must tie up capital and fund distinct task attempts, rather than minting unlimited names for free. The rule applies equally on tundra routes, ivory exchanges, and the bridge between them.
